name: Mooserkreuz
beschreibung: The Hotel Mooserkreuz is located in the Sonnberg district of Kirchdorf in Tirol, nestled in the landscape of the Kitzbüheler Alpen. Its position on a southern slope affords a wide view over the Leukental. The hotel offers a wellness area with sauna and steam bath. The rooms are furnished in alpine style, and many have a balcony. The atmosphere at the hotel is down-to-earth and familial. The restaurant serves a breakfast buffet as well as an evening meal with traditional Tiroler dishes made from regional ingredients. Half board can be booked. The hotel is especially suitable for guests who want a quiet active holiday, for example for hiking, biking or skiing.
